title: Undang-undang & Hak
canDo: Read and understand the gist of a basic contract
Discuss tenant/worker rights in general terms
Ask clarifying questions about legal terms
Understand where to seek legal help/advice
lifeBenefit: Understand your basic rights and contracts well enough to protect yourself and know when to seek help.

vocab.example: Apa tanggungjawab saya di bawah kontrak ni?
vocab.exampleEn: What are my responsibilities under this contract?

vocab.example: Sila baca syarat dan terma sebelum tandatangan.
vocab.exampleEn: Please read the terms and conditions before signing.

vocab.example: Saya cadangkan awak dapatkan nasihat guaman.
vocab.exampleEn: I suggest you get legal advice.
This could be considered a breach of contract.

vocab.example: Biro Bantuan Guaman boleh bantu awak percuma.
vocab.exampleEn: The Legal Aid Bureau can help you for free.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'What are my rights and responsibilities under this contract?'
practiceExercises.answer: Apa hak dan tanggungjawab saya di bawah kontrak ni?

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'This could be a breach of the terms and conditions.'
practiceExercises.answer: Ini boleh jadi pelanggaran syarat dan terma.

scenario.setting: Asking clarifying questions before signing an employment contract

script.ms: Maaf, saya ada beberapa soalan pasal kontrak ni sebelum tandatangan.
script.en: Excuse me, I have a few questions about this contract before signing.

script.ms: Sila, apa yang awak nak tahu?
script.en: Please, what would you like to know?

script.ms: Apa tanggungjawab saya kalau saya nak berhenti awal?
script.en: What are my responsibilities if I want to resign early?

script.ms: Awak perlu bagi notis sebulan, ikut syarat dan terma.
script.en: You need to give one month's notice, per the terms and conditions.

script.ms: Baik, dan kalau ada pertikaian, saya boleh dapatkan nasihat guaman?
script.en: Alright, and if there's a dispute, can I get legal advice?

script.ms: Boleh, Biro Bantuan Guaman ada perkhidmatan percuma.
script.en: Yes, the Legal Aid Bureau has a free service.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are an HR officer explaining employment contract terms to a new hire who is asking clarifying questions. Explain clearly and point to legal aid resources when relevant. Standard, professional register.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the contract-review dialogue, focusing on precise legal/standard vocabulary.
Ask the AI HR officer persona clarifying questions about a contract term of your choice.
Explain in 90 seconds, in your own words, three things you would check before signing any contract.
